showcase.zh: 逆用规则不是从已知往下推，而是对着目标往回推：目标和规则的结论合一，换成规则的前提
showcase.en: the rule part does not reason down from what is known but back from the goal: the goal is unified with the rule’s conclusion and replaced by its premises

t.zh: 有了合一器，规则就能倒着用，这叫<wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>。新元件<part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>：从「规则」口接入一条规则，它把第一个目标和规则的结论合一，再把这个目标换成规则的前提，每条前提一个新目标。证明板上的每个元件，在这块板上都是给出它那条规则的元件；几个规则元件可以串起来接入。
t.en: With the unifier, rules can be used backwards: <wiki-ref to="backward"></wiki-ref>. A new part, <part-ref to="part:rule"></part-ref>: wire a rule into its port “Rules”; it unifies the first goal with the rule’s conclusion and replaces that goal with the rule’s premises, one new goal for each. Every proof-board part is, on this board, a part that gives its rule, and several rule parts can be chained into one list.

t.zh: 证明核的规则都写成 ⟦前提⟧ ⟹ 结论。从这里起，线上传的是<wiki-ref to="proof-state"></wiki-ref>：尚未证完的目标。
t.en: The kernel’s rules are all written ⟦premises⟧ ⟹ conclusion. From here on a wire carries a <wiki-ref to="proof-state"></wiki-ref>: the goals still open.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，把每一个目标变成要的样子。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that turns each goal into the one wanted.

hint.zh: 三个目标都是「若…则…」。证明核里，哪条规则造出「若…则…」？
hint.en: The three goals are all “if … then …”. Which of the kernel’s rules makes an “if … then …”?
